title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 — Integrated Practice Simulation Two (Stability Check)
prompt: In many countries, governments now fund large public projects such as new transport systems and cultural centres, while some people argue that this money would be better spent on smaller local services that affect daily life. To what extent do the advantages of spending public money on large projects outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为综合模拟二（稳定性检查）的学术类 Task 2 练习。请先准确判断题型：题目要求你评估“大型公共项目支出”的利弊权衡，并明确回答 advantages 是否 outweigh disadvantages，而不是单纯列举优缺点。写作时须给出清晰立场，并在正文中用分论点支持该立场，同时回应反方观点。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。建议用约 40 分钟完成，写完后检查：是否直接回应了 outweigh 问题、每个主体段是否有明确主题句、例子是否相关且不过度虚构统计数字。
